changelog:
Initial release of the "complete-invention-disclosures-rd" skill.

- Guides inventors and R&D teams through a structured seven-step English invention-disclosure workflow.
- Organizes rough technical notes, identifies missing technical support, and generates a structured draft for review.
- Uses a standalone HTML guide asset for interactive disclosure without requiring network access.
- Provides precise prompts for technical, contextual, and evidence-based information without generating claims or legal assessments.
- Supports optional, user-requested PatSnap prior art research while preserving confidentiality and compliance requirements.
summary: Guide inventors and R&D teams through a seven-step English invention-disclosure workflow, organize rough technical notes, identify missing technical support, and generate a structured draft for inventor and qualified patent-professional review. Use when a user has an idea, product note, paper abstract, experiment record, design discussion, or incomplete disclosure that must be made technically complete without drafting claims or providing legal conclusions.
